revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found — all quotes check out against the transcript. However, Stage 3's central framing of the call opening is flawed and needs correction on rerun: the transcript shows an initial voicemail/mix-up (00:00-00:19) followed by the rep explicitly re-confirming identity at 01:45-01:51 ('Am I speaking to the same person, or is this Brittan?' / 'This is Brittan.'), which establishes that the person answering questions from 02:02 onward IS the actual lead, Brittan/Briton Duncan — not a third party relaying to the homeowner as Stage 3's starting_state and cherry_pick_moments[0] imply. Rerun should: (1) revise starting_state to remove the speculative 'took the call over from someone else, presumably family member/roommate' framing and instead note the call opened with a voicemail pickup and a brief identity mix-up that the rep correctly resolved before the verify section; (2) revise cherry_pick_moments[0]'s classification/reasoning to reflect that the rep's identity re-check at 01:46 was a reasonable recovery, tempering the 'intro_legitimacy_omission' framing or at least crediting the recovery; (3) reconsider the alternative_hypothesis in cherry_pick_moments[3] (bill anchor), which uses outcome-based hindsight (the later credit DQ) to excuse a real-time coaching gap the rep couldn't have anticipated when asking the bill question — this reasoning should be dropped or reframed since it retroactively justifies a miss using information not available to the rep at that point in the call. These are moderate, not fatal, issues — the core trajectory read (mechanical verify call ending in legitimate hard DQ) is sound and doesn't require a full rerun.
